title: overflow-rail — one row of items that continues past the trailing edge
idea: One row of items that runs past the trailing edge of the band and is cut mid-item. The visible fragment is the message: there is more here than the band can hold.
why_new: every row in the catalog fits. A set of twenty items today becomes either a tall grid or an arbitrary top-six, and both lose the fact that the set is large.
built_from: one full-aligned group with a non-wrapping flex row and a scroll container, plus the progress hairline.
risk: horizontal scroll is an accessibility and discoverability hazard, so it needs keyboard reachability, a visible affordance, and a wrap-to-grid fallback. Gate to sets of eight or more, or the cut edge is a lie.
